activity_function_definitions.question: What upper social-output function is realized?

values.definition: Publicly attributable coercive, destructive, exploitative, criminal or pathologically adversarial action or record.
Mobilization, public argument or sustained intervention for a cause, population or collective claim.
Attributable creation and public transmission of authored verbal, textual, musical or symbolic content.
Public formulation, mediation, transmission or institutional embodiment of a belief, spiritual or metaphysical system.
Measurable bodily execution, competition, exploration or physical performance.
Discovery, explanation, testing, systematization or transmission of knowledge.
Formation, coordination, direction or durable operation of a collective organization or enterprise.
Public embodiment or interpretation of affect, narrative, music, character or symbolic content through performance.
Exercise, design or maintenance of public rule, law, policy, governance or formal institutional authority.
Design, construction or implementation of a technical artifact, product, method, infrastructure or operative system.
Creation, composition, curation or direction of publicly realized visual, spatial or screen form.
Evidence supports an upper function not representable by the eleven frozen classes; the new-function detail and evidence must remain visible and cannot be forced into an old class.
